messages:
dylan: CI: eval-runner/structured-toolcall flaked on master after the quantized rascov-l7 bring-up. failing test is `test_toolcall_end_to_end` and it's intermittent :thinking:
carla: repro attempt on my laptop failed, but CI repro log attached below — looks like JSON parse error from the toolcall parser
alice: can you paste the exact error from the job log? I want to see which schema field exploded
dylan: here's the snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected schema match
E   received: {"action": "fetch", "params": "[1,2]"}
E   expected: {"action": "fetch", "params": [1,2]}
```
carla: ahhh params got serialized as a string somewhere during kv-cache restore when using the quantized runtime :grimacing:
ben: that would explain why the JSON schema validator in the eval harness throws — we validate types strictly for toolcall tests now
eva: quick idea: maybe the runner's deserialization path sets `ensure_ascii=True` or double-encodes lists when restored from prefix cache. i'll try a minimal repro that hits kv restore + quant path
ci-bot: build #4821 — eval-runner/structured-toolcall — flaky (failed 1/3) — https://ci.internal/4821 :warning:
dylan: thanks @eva. if you can repro locally, add a unit test that mimics the cached-kv payload shape and we can guard the parser
carla: also noticed the dashboard metric `toolcall_success_rate.v1` dipped around the deploy window — might be correlated. grafana alert muted for the deploy tho :roll_eyes:
alice: putting a quick patch on a branch to coerce types before schema validation (defensive) — if it fixes flake we'll investigate root cause separately. pushing in 5m
ben: +1 for bandaid, but we should add a CI lint that catches serialized-types-in-cache. Might be a new rule in eval-harness runner
eva: local repro ready, pushing test into `eng-ml/evals/tests/test_kv_deserialize.py`. test fails before patch, passes after coercion.
dylan: great. can you attach the failing payload? saves time for the runtime folks
eva: payload (trimmed): `{"kv": [{"key": "prefix_123", "value": "{\"action\": \"fetch\", \"params\": \"[1,2]\"}"}]}`
carla: omg nested quoting. looks like we have double-serialization in the path that writes to cache. filing a runtime issue: RUNTIME-238
ben: note for release notes: quantized bring-up caused toolcall schema flake, patched with defensive deserialization. we'll pair with an integration test
alice: landed quickfix -> PR #9012. CI job queued.
ci-bot: PR #9012 — eval-harness: defensive kv deserialize for toolcall tests — build #4824 started
dylan: leaving follow-up to runtime team to trace write path. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
